name: core-algorithms-system-design
description: Use when the user asks about consistent hashing, hash rings and virtual nodes, rendezvous or jump hash, Bloom filter false positive rate, Count-Min Sketch, HyperLogLog, top-k, Merkle trees or geohash. Produces sizing formulas, code and when to use each. Not for rate limiting (use rate-limiting) or shard topology (use architecture-database-scaling).
